objective: Add a responsive VAIXLNS research-to-reality monitoring screen that presents the current Undermind deep-search snapshot, the full governed research lifecycle, evidence boundaries, blockers, and follow-up navigation without claiming an unconnected live feed.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard is responsive and accessible with Arabic RTL and English technical labels.
Current Undermind searches are shown with exact titles, states, and workspace deep links.
Research lifecycle covers source discovery through controlled integration, monitoring, and evolution.
Every status distinguishes live provider observation, stored snapshot, proposal, and unverified integration.
No provider credentials or secret-bearing endpoints are embedded in client code.
Status data can be updated independently of the HTML.
Tests assert required stages, search identities, safety labels, and no false live-connectivity claim.
rollback: Revert only the feature branch commits; preserve all source data and existing repository history. No merge is part of this task.
independent_review: NOT_RUN — connector workflow cannot provide independent code review or local browser execution.
